proposals.before: Xiao Hui came with his son, Prince Su of Yidu, and his civil and military staff to the camp gate to surrender; Yuchi Jiong received them with full courtesy.
proposals.after: Xiao Hui came with Ji's son, Prince Su of Yidu, and his civil and military staff to the camp gate to surrender; Yuchi Jiong received them with full courtesy.
proposals.reason: Chinese 撝與紀子宜都王肅 means Hui together with Ji's son Prince Su of Yidu, not Hui's own son.

proposals.before: Hui together with his son, Prince Su of Yidu, and his civil and military officials and attendants came to the camp gate to request audience; Jiong received them with ceremony.
proposals.after: Hui together with Ji's son, Prince Su of Yidu, and his civil and military officials and attendants came to the camp gate to request audience; Jiong received them with ceremony.
proposals.reason: Literal English wrongly makes Su Hui's son; 紀子 is Ji's son.

proposals.before: Yang Jian ordered Yun Inspector-General Wang Yi as commander-in-chief and dispatched Jing-Xiang troops to suppress him.
proposals.after: Yang Jian ordered Xiang Inspector-General Wang Yi as commander-in-chief and dispatched Jing-Xiang troops to suppress him.
proposals.reason: Chinese 襄州總管 is Xiang, not Yun; literal mistranslates the province.

proposals.before: From the crown prince against Tuyuhun, he fought hard and had merit.
proposals.after: He accompanied the crown prince against Tuyuhun, fought hard, and had merit.
proposals.reason: Literal omits the verb of accompanying present in 從皇太子 and reads as a fragment.

decisions.after: Xiao Hui came with Xiao Ji's son, Prince Su of Yidu, and his civil and military staff to the camp gate to surrender; Yuchi Jiong received them with full courtesy.
decisions.reason: s0039 has 撝與紀子宜都王肅: 紀子 names Su as Xiao Ji's son, not Hui's; using Xiao Ji's full name corrects the kinship without leaving an ambiguous English reference.

decisions.after: Hui together with Xiao Ji's son, Prince Su of Yidu, and his civil and military officials and attendants came to the camp gate to request audience; Jiong received them with ceremony.
decisions.reason: The same 紀子 in s0039 makes Su Xiao Ji's son; the literal “his son” wrongly attaches him to Hui, and the full name keeps the corrected kinship unambiguous.
s0175 has 襄州總管王誼; 襄 is Xiang, not Yun, so “Xiang Inspector-General” correctly matches the Chinese office title.
s0113 從皇太子討吐谷渾 means he accompanied the crown prince on the campaign; “From the crown prince” misreads 從 and is ungrammatical, and the proposed literal restores that sense.
